summary: Lets BGP operators attach a short freeform message to the Cease NOTIFICATION messages for Administrative Shutdown and Administrative Reset, explaining why a session was shut down or reset. It updates RFC 4486 and was replaced by RFC 9003.

eli5.summary: When a network cuts a connection, it can leave a note saying why, like a sign on a closed shop. It has been replaced by RFC 9003.

questions: what is the bgp shutdown communication
how long can a bgp shutdown message be
subtitle: A way for a BGP router to say why it is closing a session, in a short text note inside the message itself.

tldr.problem: Operators find it hard to match a BGP session teardown with a notice sent by email or phone.
tldr.mechanism: The Cease NOTIFICATION for Administrative Shutdown or Administrative Reset may carry a length byte and up to 128 octets of UTF-8 text explaining the reason.
tldr.outcome: The note travels with the teardown, but it was later replaced by RFC 9003.

today: RFC 8203 is a Proposed Standard that has been obsoleted by RFC 9003, which is the one to read now. It updated RFC 4486.

sections.title: Why Add a Reason to a Shutdown
sections.content: It can be troublesome for an operator to correlate a BGP-4 session teardown with a notice sent by offline methods such as email or telephone calls. RFC 8203 updates RFC 4486 by letting a short freeform UTF-8 message ride inside the Cease NOTIFICATION message, telling the peer why the session is being shut down or reset.
sections.eli5: Instead of phoning a neighbour to explain why you hung up, you put the reason in the hang-up message itself.

sections.title: The Shutdown Communication Format
sections.content:
A BGP speaker that sends a NOTIFICATION with Error Code 6 (Cease) and Error Subcode 2 (Administrative Shutdown) or 4 (Administrative Reset) MAY add a UTF-8 string. Its content is at the operator's discretion.

After the subcode comes an 8-bit Length field that counts the octets of the text. It MUST range from 0 to 128 inclusive, and zero means no text follows. The text MUST be UTF-8, is not NUL terminated, and a receiver MUST NOT interpret invalid UTF-8 sequences. With multibyte characters, the number of characters is smaller than the length value.

How the message is reported is implementation specific but SHOULD include methods such as Syslog.
sections.eli5: The note has a size label first, then the words. The note can be at most 128 bytes long, so it has to be short.

sections.title: Writing a Useful Message
sections.content: Operators are encouraged to use the Shutdown Communication to give the reason for the shutdown and include out-of-band reference materials. The RFC's example is [TICKET-1-1438367390] software upgrade; back in 2 hours. It has a ticket reference meaningful to both sides, a brief human-readable reason and an indication of how long the maintenance will last. The receiver can search an email archive for the ticket string to find more details.
sections.eli5: A good note says which job it is about, what is happening and when it will be done.

sections.title: Handling Bad Messages
sections.content: If a Shutdown Communication arrives with an invalid Length value or an invalid UTF-8 sequence, a message about the event SHOULD be logged for the operator. The malformed content itself MAY be logged in hexdump format.
sections.eli5: If the note is garbled or the wrong size, the receiver writes down that something odd arrived instead of trying to read it.

sections.title: Security and IANA Notes
sections.content:
UTF-8 has known security issues, so implementers are pointed to Unicode Technical Report #36, and UTF-8 "Shortest Form" encoding is REQUIRED. Because these messages are likely to show up in syslog output, a crafted message could be formatted to look like extra syslog messages. The 128-octet limit limits that risk.

Unless the BGP transport provides integrity, a Shutdown Communication could be forged, and without confidentiality it could be snooped. Users should consider data minimization. IANA now also references this document for subcodes 2 and 4 in the Cease NOTIFICATION message subcodes registry.
sections.eli5: Since anyone might try to trick a reader with a fake note, the note is kept short and the receiver must be careful reading it.

fields.name: Length
fields.desc: Octets of text that follow, 0 to 128.

fields.name: Text
fields.desc: Start of the UTF-8 Shutdown Communication, which continues for Length octets.
